name: Berean Standard Bible
description: Readable contemporary English; the foundational reading edition.
editionLabel: Current, updated to 3rd Printing (publisher download listing)
authority: Official bsb.txt supplies verbatim Scripture; official USJ supplies structure, headings and notes. Exact reviewed alignment differences retained separately.
rights: Public-domain dedication effective April 30, 2023; all uses freely permitted, including commercial reproduction and adaptation.

name: Berean Literal Bible — publisher draft
description: Literal English. This download is labeled an early draft by the publisher; brackets mark supplied English words.
editionLabel: Berean Literal Bible (Draft), official TXT snapshot, 2026-09-05; no publisher release number supplied.
authority: Official blb.txt, UTF-8. Verse layout: this artifact supplies no paragraph, heading or note markup.
rights: Berean public-domain dedication, also printed in the downloaded text.
excluded: publisher notes unavailable in this artifact

name: Majority Standard Bible
description: Readable English. The publisher identifies Robinson–Pierpont as its basis, without specifying the exact underlying release.
editionLabel: Official MSB TXT snapshot 2026-09-05 with publisher repository USJ v5.9 structure and notes.
authority: Official msb.txt (Windows-1252) governs wording; MSB_usj v5.9 governs paragraphing, headings and publisher notes. All differences recorded.
rights: Berean texts are public domain; repository LICENSING_INFO.md expressly includes USJ Bible text formats.

name: Young’s Literal Translation (1898)
description: Literal, archaic British English. Not a translation of the selected Boyd Greek compilation.
editionLabel: YLT 1898 per eBible metadata; engylt source 2025-12-12, generated 2026-08-08; retrieved 2026-09-05.
authority: eBible engylt USFX, independently reconciled against its verse-per-line export.
rights: eBible identifies the Robert Young translation as Public Domain; archived copr.htm and metadata identify this transcription.
excluded: unverified identity with selected Greek TR

name: Nestle 1904 — historical critical Greek
description: Historical critical Greek edition, using the dos Santos transcription. It is not the exact Greek behind BSB or BLB.
editionLabel: Nestle 1904, Diego Renato dos Santos transcription; biblicalhumanities/Nestle1904 commit 713f28a3b7d4d66132f5aa809fa223fe79762e5d.
authority: Pinned xhtml/*-ap.xhtml base text. Source brackets, Mark’s alternative ending and the source’s 1913 annotation are retained.
rights: The xhtml README records the transcriber’s public-domain declaration. CrossWire independently identifies Nestle1904 as public domain. Repository layers have separate rights.

name: Robinson–Pierpont 2018
description: Named Byzantine Greek edition. Separate publisher alternatives are retained for John 7:53–8:11 and Acts 24:6–8.
editionLabel: Robinson–Pierpont 2018; official repository v3.3.2, commit 27a45ff1b7be6c17ccbfeac414f3f55732ae8e28; README text state 2023-07-20.
authority: Official csv-unicode/ccat/no-variants main text. PA.csv and ACT24.csv remain separate alternatives; ¶ is a paragraph marker.
rights: Official repository dedicates its code and text to the public domain.

name: Textus Receptus — Boyd compilation (2022)
description: Boyd’s named compilation of Stephanus, Elzevir and Scrivener readings. This is not Scrivener 1894.
editionLabel: Robert Adam Boyd, September 2022 compilation; eBible grctr source/export 2026-09-03, retrieved 2026-09-05.
authority: eBible grctr USFX, independently reconciled against its verse-per-line export. Subscriptions and comparison notes remain separate from verse text.
rights: eBible identifies the Greek text as Public Domain and expressly records Adam Boyd’s public-domain dedication of manuscript comparison footnotes.
